required_evidence: Establish that the canonical map F(S) -> F_Zar(S), with both values defined by the specified neighborhood colimits, is an isomorphism for every field k and every finite nonempty point set in smooth quasi-projective X.

Justify each invoked geometric result with hypotheses that match the actual homotopy invariant presheaf with transfers and essentially smooth semilocal setting. Correct direct application of MVW Lemma 22.12 is sufficient.

When using a reconstruction proof, justify both injectivity and surjectivity and preserve the distinction between sections on the original covering opens, sections after shrinking, and the resulting semilocal colimits.
critical_errors: Use the original Proposition 4.23 as though it established short exactness for every unchanged two-open cover, without a valid independent justification.
Treat F as a Zariski sheaf before proving or otherwise justifying the relevant comparison.
Pass from stalkwise equality at individual points directly to equality of presheaf values on a semilocal scheme without a valid descent or comparison argument.
Use a shrinking lemma in a colimit argument without checking that the shrunk neighborhoods remain in the same cofinal neighborhood system.
Silently impose that k is perfect or infinite, or that the points of Sigma are closed in X; proving only such a restricted result is not completion of this task.
Conflate the closed points of S with closed points of X, or require all intersections of semilocal localizations to be semilocal.
Infer the existence of transfers on a separated quotient or sheafification merely from the ordinary presheaf quotient or sheafification universal property.
Confuse a proved known theorem with a new independent reconstruction of all standard-triple geometry, or claim Lean/human/model evidence not present.
completion_policy: A correct direct citation of the applicable known main theorem, with object and hypothesis matching, fully completes the mathematical task. The author route, repair history, auxiliary MV exactness theorem, optional abelian-group illustration and all standard-triple geometry are not additional candidate obligations.
open_task_policy: Accept any independently verified argument within the actual hypotheses, including a valid shorter route. Explicitly added-assumption results are separate legitimate contributions and must not be reported as the original all-fields/all-finite-point-sets goal. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
